introduction_markdown: CAMEROON GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD, General Certificate of Education Examination, June 2020, Ordinary Level, Additional Mathematics, Paper 2 (0575). Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A and ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. IN SECTIONS B AND C, ALL QUESTIONS CARRY EQUAL MARKS. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C but NOT a combination of all three. Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory, answer all questions). Section B: Mechanics (if this section is chosen, then Section C may not be chosen; answer any two questions). Section C: Statistics and Probability (if this section is chosen, then Section B may not be chosen; answer any two questions). All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take g as 10 m s^-2. Formulae Booklets may be used.

questions.enonce_markdown: (i) (a) Draw a histogram of this distribution. *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Marks are whole numbers, so the classes $1$-$5$, $6$-$10$, ... have class boundaries $0.5$-$5.5$, $5.5$-$10.5$, ..., $35.5$-$40.5$. All classes have the same width $5$, so the height of each bar can be the frequency itself.

| Class boundaries | $0.5$-$5.5$ | $5.5$-$10.5$ | $10.5$-$15.5$ | $15.5$-$20.5$ | $20.5$-$25.5$ | $25.5$-$30.5$ | $30.5$-$35.5$ | $35.5$-$40.5$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Height (frequency) | 3 | 5 | 8 | 14 | 12 | 9 | 5 | 4 |

Suggested scale: $2$ cm for $5$ marks on the horizontal axis (from $0.5$ to $40.5$), $1$ cm for $2$ students on the vertical axis (up to $14$). Draw eight adjacent rectangles with no gaps, label both axes ("Marks", "Number of students") and give the histogram a title. The tallest bar is over $15.5$-$20.5$.
themes: histogram and mode of grouped data

questions.enonce_markdown:
From the histogram or otherwise,

(b) find the mode of the distribution. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The modal class is the class with the highest frequency: $16$-$20$ (boundaries $15.5$-$20.5$, $f=14$).

Using the formula

$$\text{mode}=L+\frac{d_1}{d_1+d_2}\times c,$$

where $L=15.5$ (lower boundary of the modal class), $c=5$ (class width), $d_1=14-8=6$ (excess over the previous class) and $d_2=14-12=2$ (excess over the next class):

$$\text{mode}=15.5+\frac{6}{6+2}\times5=15.5+3.75=19.25.$$

(On the histogram this is the abscissa of the point where the two lines joining the corners of the tallest bar to the corners of the neighbouring bars cross.)

**The mode is about $19.25$ marks.**
themes: histogram and mode of grouped data
